description.short_caption: Erythematous lesion with central ulceration on the cheek.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a close-up view of the cheek. A well-demarcated, erythematous lesion with a raised border and central ulceration is visible. The surrounding skin appears unremarkable, with no significant erythema or swelling extending beyond the lesion. The lesion's features suggest a localized skin infection or other dermatologic condition.
